import { SNSClient, PublishCommand } from "@aws-sdk/client-sns";
import { SQSClient, SendMessageCommand, ReceiveMessageCommand } from "@aws-sdk/client-sqs";

export async function publishSNS(client: SNSClient) {
  return client.send(new PublishCommand({
    TopicArn: "arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:000:order-events",
    Message: "hello",
  }));
}

export async function sendSQS(client: SQSClient) {
  return client.send(new SendMessageCommand({
    QueueUrl: "https://sqs.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/000/orders-queue",
    MessageBody: "v",
  }));
}

export async function receiveSQS(client: SQSClient) {
  return client.send(new ReceiveMessageCommand({
    QueueUrl: "https://sqs.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/000/audit-queue",
  }));
}
